correctness.rationale: Reconstructed apex/base signed-height geometry centered at G=(0,0,h/4). For generic oriented n_z>0, section has five vertices iff exactly one of four base vertices has positive height. Each disjoint one-positive sign event is one trivariate Gaussian positive orthant with equal squared normal length S=4a²+4b²+h²; correlations 8a²/S-1, 8b²/S-1, 2h²/S-1. Gaussian arcsine sign formula gives P5=(4/pi)∑asin(sqrt(p_i))-2, where p=(4a²,4b²,h²)/S. For x>y>0, x+y<1, derivative balancing strictly increases ∑asin(sqrt p_i), giving unique optimum p_i=1/3, i.e. a=b,h=2a; positive orthant gives P>0, boundary gives unattained infimum 0. Independently enumerated crossing edges for Gaussian normals for 40,000 directions each for (a,b,h)=(1,1,2),(1,2,3),(1,1,0.1); frequencies agree with formula to sampling precision, not proof.
